info.name: PlanRadar's API Documentation Approval Requests V2 Forms V2 API
Returns all ticket types of a specific project

params.name: project_id
params.description: if you want to load the ticket types of all projects set the project_id to 0

params.name: last_sync_date
params.description: is a Unix Timestamp. If it is set, only ticket types that were created after that timestamp will be returned

params.name: page
params.description: sets the number of pages for the returned ticket types

params.name: pagesize
params.description:
sets the number of ticket types that should be returned per page
Maximum is 500, default is 100

params.name: apply_form_display_permission
params.description: (KFT-338) when true, filters bound ticket_type_projects to forms the caller's role can see (capabilities.visible_to match or unrestricted). Watchers bypass. Results are cached per flag value. Default false.

params.name: apply_form_edit_permission
params.description: (KFT-338) when true, filters bound ticket_type_projects to forms the caller's role can edit (capabilities.editable_by match or unrestricted). Independent of the display flag. Default false.

items.docs: This API returns all forms aka ticket_types of a specific project or all the projects the user is involved in.</br>
